# Monitor 7: System Disposal (M-7)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | Monitor (M), system level |
| Phases | Operations and Support (PH-OS) (primary) |
| Depends on | Monitor 6: Ongoing Authorization (M-6) |
| Inputs | System Security Plan (ART-SSP), Hardware and software inventory (ART-INV), System risk assessment (ART-RA), Organizational risk context (ART-ORG-CONTEXT) |
| Outputs | Disposal plan (ART-DISP), produces; Hardware and software inventory (ART-INV), updates; System Security Plan (ART-SSP), updates |
| Writes facts | — |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PM/SO (PER-PM), ISSM (PER-ISSM) · A: PM/SO (PER-PM) · C: AODR (PER-AODR), IO (PER-IO), ISSO (PER-ISSO), Privacy (PER-PRIV), RE (PER-RE), Component CISO (PER-CISO) · I: AO (PER-AO) · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |

Purpose: Implement the disposal strategy and execute the required actions when the system is removed from operation.

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: M-7 is the next action, and
   M-6 is done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/M.yaml`):
   - A decision to remove the system from operation.
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what M-7 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step M
   (Monitor) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: M-7`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-DISP** (Disposal plan): System disposal strategy and the actions taken when the system is removed from operation.
     Read `templates/artifacts/ART-DISP.md`, replace every `<<FILL: ...>>` placeholder, delete the template
     comment, and write `artifacts/ART-DISP.md` with `produced_by_task: M-7` and
     `touched_by: [M-7]`.
     Write `artifacts/data/disposal.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/disposal.schema.json`, template `templates/data/disposal.yaml`); summarize its records in the Markdown by ID instead of copying them.
   - **ART-INV** (Hardware and software inventory, updated): Read `artifacts/ART-INV.md`, append `M-7` to
     `touched_by`, add a `## System Disposal (M-7)` section with what this task
     established, and write the whole file back. Keep every earlier section.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/inventory.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/inventory.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
   - **ART-SSP** (System Security Plan, updated): Read `artifacts/ART-SSP.md`, append `M-7` to
     `touched_by`, add a `## System Disposal (M-7)` section with what this task
     established, and write the whole file back. Keep every earlier section.
     Rewrite `artifacts/ssp/controls/<fam>.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/ssp-controls.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/ssp-records.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/ssp-records.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/plan-reviews.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/plan-reviews.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/scrm-plan.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/scrm-plan.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
   Why: `rmf status` counts M-7 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** M-7 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task M-7`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Facts

M-7 writes no facts.

## Done when

- A system disposal strategy is developed and implemented, as needed (DoDI 8510.01 Table 7 outcome).
- ART-DISP records the disposal strategy, media sanitization and registry and inventory updates.
- The inventory of information systems shows the removal; ART-INV and ART-SSP list M-7 in touched_by, and registration.yaml updates holds the disposal update by M-7 (UPD-001).
- disposal.yaml media records each class of media and equipment disposed of under the issuances that govern it, DoDM 5200.01 Volume 3 and CNSSI 4004.1 for classified media, NIST SP 800-88 for unclassified, CNSSI 4004.1 for a destruction unless the media are unclassified and destroyed under SP 800-88 (DISP-001).
- `artifacts/ART-DISP.md` lists M-7 in `touched_by` and has `produced_by_task: M-7`.
- `artifacts/ART-INV.md` lists M-7 in `touched_by`.
- `artifacts/ART-SSP.md` lists M-7 in `touched_by`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: M-7`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task M-7` reports 0 errors.
